description: This source file defines a custom exception class OAuth2 within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 exception namespace. It extends a base Exception class and provides additional context and logging level methods specific to OAuth2-related errors.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: A custom exception class for OAuth2-related errors in the SuiteCRM platform, providing additional context and logging functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth2 exception with a message, code, and optional previous exception, prefixing the message with '[OAuth2]'.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Provides a fixed string indicating that an unhandled OAuth2 exception has occurred.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level for this exception, specifically ERROR as per PSR-3 standards.
